mapper.sql: a.activity_id, a.customer_id, c.customer_name, a.opportunity_id, o.opportunity_no, o.opportunity_name, a.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, a.activity_type, a.subject, a.activity_at, a.location, a.content, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.version

where.if: AND ( LOWER(a.subject) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(a.content) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(c.customer_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(o.opportunity_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sales_activity a INNER JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN sales_opportunity o ON o.opportunity_id = a.opportunity_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id
ORDER BY a.activity_at DESC, a.activity_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_activity a INNER JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN sales_opportunity o ON o.opportunity_id = a.opportunity_id

SELECT FROM sales_activity a INNER JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN sales_opportunity o ON o.opportunity_id = a.opportunity_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE a.activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_activity ( customer_id, opportunity_id, employee_id, activity_type, subject, activity_at, location, content, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{activity.customerId}, #{activity.opportunityId}, #{activity.employeeId}, #{activity.activityType}, #{activity.subject}, #{activity.activityAt}, #{activity.location}, #{activity.content}, #{actorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_activity SET opportunity_id = #{opportunityId}, employee_id = #{employeeId}, activity_type = #{activityType}, subject = #{subject}, activity_at = #{activityAt}, location = #{location}, content = #{content}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND version = #{version}
